CONFLICT: the NACDA final PDF ranks Biola 25th (429), behind St. Francis (IL) at 24th (432.5). Biola news (https://athletics.biola.edu/news/2015/6/12/GEN_0612150601.aspx) says 24th of 186. The official document is used here. Biola led the fall standings.

Biola's best-ever finish in any series. Led after fall and winter (560 pts). Matches https://athletics.biola.edu/news/2016/6/14/general-eagles-place-7th-in-directors-cup.aspx. The NACDA archive's 2015-16 'Winter' link actually serves the fall file.
Last NAIA year (NCAA provisional year one). Matches https://athletics.biola.edu/news/2017/6/9/general-biola-university-records-another-top-20-directors-cup-finish.aspx

Provisional year one. Biola competed in NAIA and placed 18th in the NAIA cup that year. Biola was an NCAA DII provisional member, so it could not score in the DII Directors' Cup. Checked: Biola is not in this final DII PDF. It is listed as 'did not place' but was ineligible, not an eligible school that missed out.

Provisional year two, first PacWest season. Biola was an NCAA DII provisional member, so it could not score in the DII Directors' Cup. Checked: Biola is not in this final DII PDF. It is listed as 'did not place' but was ineligible, not an eligible school that missed out. Also not in the NAIA 2017-18 PDF (checked).

Provisional year three. Biola was an NCAA DII provisional member, so it could not score in the DII Directors' Cup. Checked: Biola is not in this final DII PDF. It is listed as 'did not place' but was ineligible, not an eligible school that missed out. Also not in the NAIA 2018-19 PDF (checked).

First year of full membership. The final standings were never published because of COVID-19 (NACDA previous-standings page: 'No Standings due to COVID-19'). The place and points shown are INTERIM: final fall standings of Dec. 19, 2019 (113th, 49 pts, all from women's cross country).
NACDA published no DII standings for 2020-21 because of COVID-19. The NAIA cup was held that year, but the DII cup was not.
First completed DII Directors' Cup for Biola. By season: fall 51, winter 0, spring 87.
Final PDF (Update 2, posted 7/24/2023). Biola's 2025 story calls 104th in 2023 its previous best.
Matches https://athletics.biola.edu/news/2024/6/28/general-eagles-land-at-108th-in-learfield-directors-cup-standings.aspx. That story cites 314 DII members; the PDF's last rank is 238.
Best DII finish. Matches https://athletics.biola.edu/news/2025/6/17/general-movin-on-up.aspx

First year of dual NCCAA membership. INTERIM: 1st after fall with 54 pts, 21 ahead of Indiana Wesleyan. Final standings not found. Campbellsville won the 2017-18 award (secondary: campbellsvilletigers.com), so Biola did not finish 1st, but its final place is unknown.

INTERIM: 1st at mid-season (Jan. 2019) with 48 pts. Final: Campbellsville 1st with 84, Grace 2nd with 70.5 (https://campbellsvilletigers.com/news/2019/5/31/general-tiger-and-lady-tiger-athletics-claim-nccaa-presidential-award-for-second-straight-year.aspx). That release says Biola won 4 titles but entered only 7 of 17 championships. Biola's final place is not given, so it was at best 3rd.

gaps: NAIA 1998-99 through 2005-06 (8 seasons): the NACDA archive keeps only the winner's press releases, which name the top 5. The full standings were on the old nacda.com site, and web.archive.org was 'Temporarily Offline' (CDX API and pages) during this research. Next step: retry Wayback for old nacda.com Directors' Cup pages, or check Biola media guides and The Chimes archives.

Biola news counts suggest 2-3 top-20 finishes and about 6 top-50 finishes fall within 1998-99 to 2005-06, but the 2016 and 2017 stories disagree on the count (the 2016 story calls 2015-16 the '8th top-20', and the 2017 story calls 2016-17 the '10th'). A 2009 search snippet says 16th in 2008-09 was Biola's best since 1995-96. That would put any earlier top-20 finishes at 17th-20th. Not verified.
NCAA DII 2019-20 and 2020-21: no final standings exist because of COVID-19. Only the 2019-20 fall interim is recorded.

NCCAA Presidential Award 2017-18 and 2018-19: final standings with Biola's place not found (only interim leads plus the names of the winners and runners-up). The date Biola's NCCAA membership ended was not verified.
2014-15 NAIA: the official PDF (25th) and the Biola news release (24th) conflict. The official PDF is used.
schools_scored is the highest rank printed in each final PDF (a proxy for schools ranked), or the count given in a Biola release where one exists. It is null where neither was clean.
